messages.text: Can a person switch from BTC to Fractal later on, or from the solo mode to a pool?

Yes. It's a standard Bitcoin miner — you point it at whatever pool or solo address you want, and you can change that any time from its web dashboard. Fractal, a pool, solo, back again; nothing is locked in.

What's your plan for it, solo lottery or steady sats?
Not sure of the differences, thinking Fractal Solo maybe.

Pool: small steady payouts to your wallet, every day. Solo on Bitcoin: nothing most of the time, but a full 3.125 BTC block if you hit. Fractal solo sits in between — blocks come far more often, worth far less, so you actually see wins.

What do you pay per kWh? I'll run the 40T's numbers for you.

At 18¢, the 40T's 650 W runs about $84 a month in power. For that you get 40 TH/s drawing on every block, around the clock, for years — and on Fractal solo you'd actually see wins land, which is the fun of it.

It's $799, ships November 30, 2026. Want me to set up the cart?
What are the typical WIFI usage/requirements?

Tiny. It talks to the pool in small text messages — a few megabytes a day at most, less than streaming a song. Any 2.4 GHz home WiFi is plenty; what matters is a stable signal where it sits, not speed.

Ready for me to build the cart?
